status: partial: the dataset, table and query tools; decode and get_manifest are not implemented

capabilities.name: open_dataset
capabilities.scope: DEX and APK paths with at least one DEX; resource-only archives are refused

capabilities.name: list_datasets
capabilities.scope: open datasets, quotas and usage in this server's own shape

capabilities.name: close_dataset
capabilities.scope: idempotent; later requests naming the dataset are refused

capabilities.name: list_tables
capabilities.scope: the 17 HostLab contract relations, not the reference's 56

capabilities.name: describe_table
capabilities.scope: columns, types, fact layers; case-insensitive name

capabilities.name: query
capabilities.scope: up to 16 statements, row windows with exact totals, TEMP and named temporary queries; equal to the frozen A0 recording; timing refused

capabilities.name: decode
capabilities.reason: not implemented (Smali; MDD-042 remainder and MDD-071)

capabilities.name: cancellation_and_progress_notifications
capabilities.reason: requests are served one at a time; a deadline closes the dataset instead

acceptance.acceptance: the five HostLab tools open_dataset/query/decode/get_manifest/close_dataset answer request by request like the reference, and the three discovery tools carry the real schema

proofs.check: tools/list: the six registered tools carry the reference engine's published schemas
A0 replay: every recorded query page equals the reference through the real server
A0 replay: every recorded refusal is refused, at the same statement index
A0 replay: damaged recordings are caught

not_proven: open_dataset and close_dataset responses: the reference's responses were never recorded and its executable is not available, so only their lifecycle behaviour is tested

acceptance.acceptance: decode produces the instructions, method context and declarations production uses, never placeholder text or opcodes alone
Smali and Manifest paging keep their own units (UTF-8 byte offsets, line counts, permission rows) and do not mix with DEX byte offsets
not_proven: decode and get_manifest: not implemented; the query tool pages in rows, whose window is proven by the replay

acceptance.acceptance: tool ownership, quotas, closing, errors and source identity are checked through real MCP JSON-RPC
the M4 capability registers only what passes; get_manifest_components, list_resource_files, read_resource and query_resources are unavailable or unregistered

residual: decode, get_manifest and the resource tools are not implemented; the clauses about them are not proven

the reference engine's executable is not on this machine, so open_dataset, close_dataset, list_tables, describe_table and list_datasets responses were never compared with it; their shapes are this server's own
only the query tool's responses were compared with the reference, through the recording made from its own MCP server
list_tables names the 17 HostLab contract relations, not the reference's 56
column data_type and nullable are derived from the returned values because the result carries no declared types; an empty column says "unknown"
a statement cannot be stopped from outside, so a deadline closes the dataset and the statement ends under the engine's own budgets
requests are served one at a time; there is no cancellation or progress
text with an unpaired surrogate has no UTF-8 form and is refused rather than repaired
archives without a DEX are refused, although the reference supports resource-only archives
one Windows host; the MCP process tests run on Linux only in the repository CI
